3426.title: Classroom
3426.caption: A spacious, well-lit classroom with eight green tables and matching chairs, set on a polished hardwood floor. the room is filled with educational materials, including wooden blocks, a dollhouse, and a variety of toys, all under natural light from windows with colorful curtains. the walls are decorated with child-friendly artwork and a whiteboard with educational posters. over time, the room's arrangement slightly changes, with the number of tables and chairs varying, and the addition of a whiteboard with chinese characters. the atmosphere is cheerful and conducive to learning, with a focus on creativity and play.
3426.short_caption: A bright, child-friendly classroom with green tables, wooden shelves, and colorful decorations, designed for learning and play.

2530.title: Succulent beds
2530.caption: A home improvement store where a customer browses through an extensive selection of plants. initially, the camera focuses on a variety of succulents and cacti on black trays, with signs indicating different plant types like 'perennials' and 'essentials'. the store is well-lit, with a concrete floor and shelves stocked with gardening supplies. as the customer moves through the aisles, the camera captures the vibrant colors and diverse textures of the plants, including rosette-forming and spiky-leaved varieties. the scene is set against a backdrop of pallets with bags of soil and fertilizer, suggesting a seasonal transition to fall.
2530.short_caption: A variety of succulents and perennials are displayed on black trays in a large indoor garden center.

1163.title: Greenhouse
1163.caption: A modern greenhouse with a gabled roof and transparent glass panels, set against a clear blue sky. the greenhouse, with a dark brown brick foundation, is surrounded by a gravel bed and a metal staircase leading to an upper level. as the frames advance, the greenhouse is shown with a metal framework, a gable roof, and a ventilation system, with young plants inside. the greenhouse's design includes a pitched roof, a gable, and a series of louvered windows. the surrounding area is tranquil, with no people or animals, and the greenhouse is connected to a white building by a walkway.
1163.short_caption: A modern greenhouse with glass walls and brick base, set against a clear blue sky, showcasing its sleek design and structural details.

1583.title: Autumn park
1583.caption: A serene autumnal park with a metal bench on a leaf-strewn path, surrounded by trees with yellow and orange leaves. a dark green trash bin is present, and the overcast sky enhances the tranquil atmosphere. as time passes, the scene remains largely unchanged, with the bench and trash bin consistently in view. the forest is a mix of birch and coniferous trees, and the ground is covered in fallen leaves. a street lamp appears, and the park's quiet solitude is emphasized by the absence of people and animals.
1583.short_caption: A serene autumn scene with a bench, trash can, and colorful trees lining a path in a park.

2387.title: Red building
2387.caption: A series of scenes showcasing a modern architectural complex with a red and white facade, reflective glass windows, and a series of white sculptures with chinese characters. the sculptures, arranged in various patterns, stand on a grassy area with patches of brown, indicating seasonal change or drought. a solitary bicycle rack and a small white object on the grass are also visible. the building's entrance is marked by a red banner with chinese text, and the overall atmosphere is serene and devoid of people, suggesting a tranquil urban setting.
2387.short_caption: A modern red building with large white chinese characters stands prominently against a grassy foreground.

1037.title: Flower greenhouse
1037.caption: A well-lit garden center, showcasing a diverse array of potted plants and flowers. the center is filled with vibrant colors, including purple petunias, yellow marigolds, blue pansies, and white daisies, all neatly organized on tables and hanging baskets. the plants are tagged with prices, ranging from $1 to $10, and some are marked with '10% off'. the center features a metal framework with a glass ceiling, allowing natural light to enhance the lively atmosphere. throughout the video, the scene remains consistent, with the plants and flowers being the central focus.
1037.short_caption: A vibrant greenhouse filled with colorful flowers and hanging baskets, showcasing a variety of plants for sale.

3035.title: Office building
3035.caption: A serene urban plaza with a modern glass-fronted building and a curved entrance, surrounded by young trees in concrete planters and a solitary bench. the clear blue sky and the absence of people create a tranquil atmosphere. as time passes, the scene includes a leafless tree and a small shrubbery, with the building's reflective windows mirroring the sky. the plaza is quiet, with no visible activity, and the surrounding greenery suggests a temperate climate. the video concludes with a view of the building's reflective facade and a young tree in a planter, emphasizing the stillness of the cityscape.
3035.short_caption: Modern office building with large glass windows and a minimalist design, surrounded by bare trees and a paved plaza.

1275.title: Forest path
1275.caption: A serene forest in autumn, with a winding dirt path cutting through the grassy underbrush and trees with yellow and orange leaves. the forest is undisturbed by wildlife or human activity, creating a tranquil atmosphere. as time passes, the colors of the leaves and the ground's texture vary slightly, with the path and trees' trunks occasionally showing signs of weathering. the scene remains peaceful and undisturbed, with the forest floor covered in a carpet of green grass and fallen leaves, and the trees' trunks and branches are etched against the soft light of an overcast sky.
1275.short_caption: A serene forest scene with tall trees and scattered fallen leaves on a grassy path.

1284.title: Furniture store
1284.caption: A furniture store's interior, starting with a display of various stools and side tables on glass shelves, including a black metal stool with a white cushion and a wooden bench with a tufted design. as the video continues, the focus shifts to showcase different types of furniture, such as chrome-legged stools, wooden benches, and a grey upholstered bench, all neatly arranged and accompanied by price tags. the store highlights modern and traditional styles, with an emphasis on the furniture's design and color, including a cream-colored stool with wooden legs and a black metal frame. the video concludes with a display of a black side table, a beige tufted ottoman, and a green velvet bench, all under bright lighting.
1284.short_caption: A variety of modern furniture pieces, including tables and stools, displayed on a wall in a store setting.
